paragraphs.text: If then ye were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.
paragraphs.original: Εἰ οὖν συνηγέρθητε τῷ Χριστῷ, τὰ ἄνω ζητεῖτε, οὗ ὁ Χριστός ἐστιν ἐν δεξιᾷ τοῦ θεοῦ καθήμενος·
paragraphs.translit: Ei oun synēgerthēte tō Christō, ta anō zēteite, hou ho Christos estin en dexia tou theou kathēmenos·

paragraphs.text: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are upon the earth.
paragraphs.original: τὰ ἄνω φρονεῖτε, μὴ τὰ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς,
paragraphs.translit: ta anō phroneite, mē ta epi tēs gēs,

paragraphs.text: For ye died, and your life is hid with Christ in God.
paragraphs.original: ἀπεθάνετε γάρ, καὶ ἡ ζωὴ ὑμῶν κέκρυπται σὺν τῷ Χριστῷ ἐν τῷ θεῷ·
paragraphs.translit: apethanete gar, kai hē zōē hymōn kekryptai syn tō Christō en tō theō·

paragraphs.text: When Christ, [who is] our life, shall be manifested, then shall ye also with him be manifested in glory.
paragraphs.original: ὅταν ὁ Χριστὸς φανερωθῇ, ἡ ζωὴ ὑμῶν, τότε καὶ ὑμεῖς σὺν αὐτῷ φανερωθήσεσθε ἐν δόξῃ.
paragraphs.translit: hotan ho Christos phanerōthē, hē zōē hymōn, tote kai hymeis syn autō phanerōthēsesthe en doxē.

paragraphs.text: Put to death therefore your members which are upon the earth: fornication, uncleanness, passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry;
paragraphs.original: Νεκρώσατε οὖν τὰ μέλη τὰ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, πορνείαν, ἀκαθαρσίαν, πάθος, ἐπιθυμίαν κακήν, καὶ τὴν πλεονεξίαν ἥτις ἐστὶν εἰδωλολατρία,
paragraphs.translit: Nekrōsate oun ta melē ta epi tēs gēs, porneian, akatharsian, pathos, epithymian kakēn, kai tēn pleonexian hētis estin eidōlolatria,

paragraphs.text: for which things` sake cometh the wrath of God upon the sons of disobedience:
paragraphs.original: διʼ ἃ ἔρχεται ἡ ὀργὴ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐπὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς τῆς ἀπειθείας·
paragraphs.translit: diʼ ha erchetai hē orgē tou theou epi tous hyious tēs apeitheias·

paragraphs.text: wherein ye also once walked, when ye lived in these things;
paragraphs.original: ἐν οἷς καὶ ὑμεῖς περιεπατήσατέ ποτε ὅτε ἐζῆτε ἐν τούτοις·
paragraphs.translit: en hois kai hymeis periepatēsate pote hote ezēte en toutois·

paragraphs.text: but now do ye also put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, railing, shameful speaking out of your mouth:
paragraphs.original: νυνὶ δὲ ἀπόθεσθε καὶ ὑμεῖς τὰ πάντα, ὀργήν, θυμόν, κακίαν, βλασφημίαν, αἰσχρολογίαν ἐκ τοῦ στόματος ὑμῶν·
paragraphs.translit: nyni de apothesthe kai hymeis ta panta, orgēn, thymon, kakian, blasphēmian, aischrologian ek tou stomatos hymōn·

paragraphs.text: lie not one to another; seeing that ye have put off the old man with his doings,
paragraphs.original: μὴ ψεύδεσθε εἰς ἀλλήλους· ἀπεκδυσάμενοι τὸν παλαιὸν ἄνθρωπον σὺν ταῖς πράξεσιν αὐτοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: mē pseudesthe eis allēlous· apekdysamenoi ton palaion anthrōpon syn tais praxesin autou,

paragraphs.text: and have put on the new man, that is being renewed unto knowledge after the image of him that created him:
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐνδυσάμενοι τὸν νέον τὸν ἀνακαινούμενον εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν κατʼ εἰκόνα τοῦ κτίσαντος αὐτόν,
paragraphs.translit: kai endysamenoi ton neon ton anakainoumenon eis epignōsin katʼ eikona tou ktisantos auton,

paragraphs.text: where there cannot be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondman, freeman; but Christ is all, and in all.
paragraphs.original: ὅπου οὐκ ἔνι Ἕλλην καὶ Ἰουδαῖος, περιτομὴ καὶ ἀκροβυστία, βάρβαρος, Σκύθης, δοῦλος, ἐλεύθερος, ἀλλὰ τὰ πάντα καὶ ἐν πᾶσιν Χριστός.
paragraphs.translit: hopou ouk eni Hellēn kai Ioudaios, peritomē kai akrobystia, barbaros, Skythēs, doulos, eleutheros, alla ta panta kai en pasin Christos.

paragraphs.text: Put on therefore, as God`s elect, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, meekness, longsuffering;
paragraphs.original: Ἐνδύσασθε οὖν ὡς ἐκλεκτοὶ τοῦ θεοῦ, ἅγιοι καὶ ἠγαπημένοι, σπλάγχνα οἰκτιρμοῦ, χρηστότητα, ταπεινοφροσύνην, πραΰτητα, μακροθυμίαν,
paragraphs.translit: Endysasthe oun hōs eklektoi tou theou, hagioi kai ēgapēmenoi, splanchna oiktirmou, chrēstotēta, tapeinophrosynēn, prautēta, makrothymian,

paragraphs.text: forbearing one another, and forgiving each other, if any man have a complaint against any; even as the Lord forgave you, so also do ye:
paragraphs.original: ἀνεχόμενοι ἀλλήλων καὶ χαριζόμενοι ἑαυτοῖς ἐάν τις πρός τινα ἔχῃ μομφήν· καθὼς καὶ ὁ κύριος ἐχαρίσατο ὑμῖν οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς·
paragraphs.translit: anechomenoi allēlōn kai charizomenoi heautois ean tis pros tina echē momphēn· kathōs kai ho kyrios echarisato hymin houtōs kai hymeis·

paragraphs.text: and above all these things [put on] love, which is the bond of perfectness.
paragraphs.original: ἐπὶ πᾶσιν δὲ τούτοις τὴν ἀγάπην, ὅ ἐστιν σύνδεσμος τῆς τελειότητος.
paragraphs.translit: epi pasin de toutois tēn agapēn, ho estin syndesmos tēs teleiotētos.

paragraphs.text: And let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, to the which also ye were called in one body; and be ye thankful.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἡ εἰρήνη τοῦ Χριστοῦ βραβευέτω ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν, εἰς ἣν καὶ ἐκλήθητε ἐν ἑνὶ σώματι· καὶ εὐχάριστοι γίνεσθε.
paragraphs.translit: kai hē eirēnē tou Christou brabeuetō en tais kardiais hymōn, eis hēn kai eklēthēte en heni sōmati· kai eucharistoi ginesthe.

paragraphs.text: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms [and] hymns [and] spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts unto God.
paragraphs.original: ὁ λόγος τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐνοικείτω ἐν ὑμῖν πλουσίως ἐν πάσῃ σοφίᾳ· διδάσκοντες καὶ νουθετοῦντες ἑαυτοὺς ψαλμοῖς, ὕμνοις, ᾠδαῖς πνευματικαῖς ἐν χάριτι, ᾄδοντες ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν τῷ θεῷ·
paragraphs.translit: ho logos tou Christou enoikeitō en hymin plousiōs en pasē sophia· didaskontes kai nouthetountes heautous psalmois, hymnois, ōdais pneumatikais en chariti, adontes en tais kardiais hymōn tō theō·

paragraphs.text: And whatsoever ye do, in word or in deed, [do] all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
paragraphs.original: καὶ πᾶν ὅ τι ἐὰν ποιῆτε ἐν λόγῳ ἢ ἐν ἔργῳ, πάντα ἐν ὀνόματι κυρίου Ἰησοῦ, εὐχαριστοῦντες τῷ θεῷ πατρὶ διʼ αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: kai pan ho ti ean poiēte en logō ē en ergō, panta en onomati kyriou Iēsou, eucharistountes tō theō patri diʼ autou.

paragraphs.text: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
paragraphs.original: Αἱ γυναῖκες, ὑποτάσσεσθε τοῖς ἀνδράσιν, ὡς ἀνῆκεν ἐν κυρίῳ.
paragraphs.translit: Hai gynaikes, hypotassesthe tois andrasin, hōs anēken en kyriō.

paragraphs.text: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.
paragraphs.original: οἱ ἄνδρες, ἀγαπᾶτε τὰς γυναῖκας καὶ μὴ πικραίνεσθε πρὸς αὐτάς.
paragraphs.translit: hoi andres, agapate tas gynaikas kai mē pikrainesthe pros autas.

paragraphs.text: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this is well-pleasing in the Lord.
paragraphs.original: Τὰ τέκνα, ὑπακούετε τοῖς γονεῦσιν κατὰ πάντα, τοῦτο γὰρ εὐάρεστόν ἐστιν ἐν κυρίῳ.
paragraphs.translit: Ta tekna, hypakouete tois goneusin kata panta, touto gar euareston estin en kyriō.

paragraphs.text: Fathers, provoke not your children, that they be not discouraged.
paragraphs.original: οἱ πατέρες, μὴ ἐρεθίζετε τὰ τέκνα ὑμῶν, ἵνα μὴ ἀθυμῶσιν.
paragraphs.translit: hoi pateres, mē erethizete ta tekna hymōn, hina mē athymōsin.

paragraphs.text: Servants, obey in all things them that are your masters according to the flesh; not with eye-service, as men-pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing the Lord:
paragraphs.original: οἱ δοῦλοι, ὑπακούετε κατὰ πάντα τοῖς κατὰ σάρκα κυρίοις, μὴ ἐν ὀφθαλμοδουλίαις, ὡς ἀνθρωπάρεσκοι, ἀλλʼ ἐν ἁπλότητι καρδίας, φοβούμενοι τὸν κύριον.
paragraphs.translit: hoi douloi, hypakouete kata panta tois kata sarka kyriois, mē en ophthalmodouliais, hōs anthrōpareskoi, allʼ en haplotēti kardias, phoboumenoi ton kyrion.

paragraphs.text: whatsoever ye do, work heartily, as unto the Lord, and not unto men;
paragraphs.original: ὃ ἐὰν ποιῆτε, ἐκ ψυχῆς ἐργάζεσθε, ὡς τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ οὐκ ἀνθρώποις,
paragraphs.translit: ho ean poiēte, ek psychēs ergazesthe, hōs tō kyriō kai ouk anthrōpois,

paragraphs.text: knowing that from the Lord ye shall receive the recompense of the inheritance: ye serve the Lord Christ.
paragraphs.original: εἰδότες ὅτι ἀπὸ κυρίου ἀπολήμψεσθε τὴν ἀνταπόδοσιν τῆς κληρονομίας· τῷ κυρίῳ Χριστῷ δουλεύετε·
paragraphs.translit: eidotes hoti apo kyriou apolēmpsesthe tēn antapodosin tēs klēronomias· tō kyriō Christō douleuete·

paragraphs.text: For he that doeth wrong shall receive again for the wrong that he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.
paragraphs.original: ὁ γὰρ ἀδικῶν κομίσεται ὃ ἠδίκησεν, καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν προσωπολημψία.
paragraphs.translit: ho gar adikōn komisetai ho ēdikēsen, kai ouk estin prosōpolēmpsia.
